message.content:
HTSUS 8541.21 covers transistors (other than photosensitive) with a dissipation rate of less than 1 W. 8541.29 covers those with a dissipation rate of 1 W or more. The maximum dissipation here is 1.1 W, so this falls under 8541.29.

Subheading 8541.29.00 has statistical suffixes. I recall 8541.29.0095 as "Other" for 8541.29.00, and I believe 8541.29.0080 and 8541.29.0075 do not exist. In the current schedule, 8541.29.00 is "Other" with a single statistical suffix of 95. I'm answering from memory of that structure rather than a check.

This looks like a CBP ruling, which probably classified the item under 8541.29.0095. The ruling would have treated the 1.1 W maximum as the controlling dissipation figure, and the 1 MHz operating frequency is irrelevant because it does not change the subheading.

```json
{"hts_code": "8541.29.0095", "reason": "The dual N/P-channel MOSFET is a transistor (not photosensitive) with a maximum power dissipation of 1.1 W, which is 1 W or more, so it falls under subheading 8541.29."}
```
